description:
Hearings scheduled in Ukrainian courts (Список справ, призначених до
розгляду), every court, read daily from court.gov.ua (a court listing on its
own portal instead: source=courtportal). The source lists today onward; past
hearings stay here as last listed. Needs case_number, court_code or q.

include_removed.description: Also hearings dropped before their date (moved/cancelled).

q.description: Words in parties, subject or judge.

name: ua_court_hearings__search
title: Search Court Hearing Schedules
